definition: dry = less than 1 mm of rain summed over the 3 days before the sampling day (the sampling day excluded); 1 d = the day before; 7 d = the 7 days before

rain_sources.oneaquahealth: OneAquaHealth API daily weather per site (precipTotalMm)
rain_sources.toulouse: Open-Meteo historical archive, default model, daily sum at 43.5966, 1.4331 (Europe/Paris days), the file behind the 6 of 30 finding; rain_2d_mm = the 2 days before the sample day, wet when >= 5 mm (thresholds.wet_mm_2d)
rain_sources.bath: Open-Meteo historical archive, default model, daily sum at Warleigh Weir (Europe/London days); gauge_* = Environment Agency Bath Claverton, gauge days 09:00-09:00 GMT, only those finished at or before the sample time
rain_sources.r48_era5_mm: the model's input: Open-Meteo ERA5 hourly rain in the 48 h before the sample time

note_900: over_900 is a single-sample flag; the EU applies 900 to a 90th percentile
